name: Along Herne, on to Võistluse, up Püssirohu
why: The way riders take from Herne towards Juhkentali and Tartu maantee. The map has 318 m of Herne as a one-way street running west, so no router offers it: ride_sections had five rides on every square of Herne heading east on 2026-11-24, and this way ridden for 84% of its length against 45% of the way offered first. The owner says bikes are allowed both ways on Herne: it is the only way.
